What is answer engine optimization?

By Jane Doe. Published 2026-09-01. Updated 2026-10-20.

What is answer engine optimization?

Answer engine optimization (AEO) is the practice of making content citable by AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity. Acme Analytics measures citation share across 4 engines weekly. In 2026, 38% of AI-cited pages ranked outside the organic top 10.

How does Acme Analytics track citations?

Acme Analytics samples 30 prompts per vertical across three engines and reports share of voice. The platform stores raw answers for audit. Teams see a weekly trend line within 2 weeks.
